title: Live now has no staleness bound: a dead operation row with status recording is shown under 'Live now' indefinitely
repro: GET /webinar-operations returns {operations:[{id:'old',title:'Yesterday job',status:'recording',attempts:1,updatedAt:<24h ago>}],omitted:0}. MeetingBotPage renders it under the h2 'Live now' with the note 'Operations currently recording or processing, from the runner's own state.' Only the small 'Last update:' line hints at age.
fix_direction: Derive 'live' from status AND a freshness bound on updatedAt (or say 'Reported as recording; last update <age>' and move rows older than a chosen threshold out of 'Live now'); a missing/invalid updatedAt should not count as live. Owner to choose the threshold; check the runner actually refreshes updatedAt while recording.
